# XP static evidence fixtures

Target executable SHA-256:
`664b4b1da036eb36b13a3bce2fd572e37127223cbf6796adde12cbfb3af0d893`.

These fixtures are **static reconstruction**, not independent runtime captures.
Independent XP runtime captures are not available. These tests are not proof
of pixel/runtime parity.
No proprietary binary, pseudocode or extracted artwork is included here.

## RNG v1

`xp-rand-v1.tsv` records twelve draws after ten warm-up draws, for seeds 0, 1,
42 and UINT32_MAX. Schema and source identity are checked by `src/reference.rs`.
Values were calculated with Python integer arithmetic from the instructions at
`_rand` (`01010786`): multiply by 214013, add 2531011 modulo 2^32, shift 16 and
mask with 0x7fff. `RandInit` (`0100e224`) supplies the ten-draw startup convention.
They were not generated by the Rust implementation under test.

## Orientation v1

`xp-orientation-v1.tsv` contains all 96 legal incoming/outgoing/notch combinations,
read directly from this PE's tables at `01084838`, `01084b98`, `01084a78` and
`01084b08`. The production integer quarter-turn transport is checked against
these values; it does not duplicate the tables or calculate its own expected rows.

Geometry checks preserve dimensions, topology, angle constants and known f32
store boundaries. Host trigonometry/matrix arithmetic is not a bit-exact emulator
of x87 or every D3DX CPU-dispatch path; runtime vertex/image comparison is deferred.

## Normal startup and exhausted-node safety

The Single/Elbow/Solid startup checkpoint in `simulation.rs` uses seed 42,
15×8×15 nodes, and the checked call order after warm-up: sample bounds
20,4,15,8,15,16,6,9,4. Static integer calculation gives RNG state `b80f4c37`,
weight 4, material 16, start (6,1,1), initial step -Y then -X, ending at (5,0,1).
This is a static instruction-derived checkpoint, not a runtime capture.

On exhausted start scans the source writes invalid final coordinates, sets
status 2, then may still call Draw; GetNode (`0100b0e0`) has no bounds checks.
The Rust model retires that failed start safely after consuming the same probes.
It does not reproduce undefined memory reads or emit geometry from invalid nodes.
This is an explicit safety exception, not a claim about reliable XP output for
that undefined path. Valid starts, traps, restarts and five-start budgets follow
the inspected normal-mode call path.

## Joint-mode checkpoints

`NORMAL_STATE` constructor/Reset/ChooseJointType (`0100c1dc`, `0100c1a2`,
`0100c1b8`) establish Cycle as 2 before the first Reset, then 0,1,2 repeatedly.
Mixed samples iRand(3) only at a turn, and returns Ball only for sample zero.
The startup checkpoint above remains `b80f4c37` for Elbow/Ball/Cycle; Mixed
consumes one further draw, giving `ccdc561e` and sample 1 (an elbow).
Tests check that straight extensions consume no joint-selection randomness.

## Multiple/chase static checkpoints

Normal solid Multiple/Elbow startup at seed 42, 15×8×15: the first discarded
active-count draw and the second draw both select 4; chase is false. After all
starts and the first drawing pass, RNG state is `dd7f06b5` and twelve nodes are
reserved. Actor (id, weight, material, head, direction) checkpoints are:
`(0,1,9,(11,6,6),+Y)`, `(1,4,4,(9,2,3),-X)`,
`(2,4,4,(1,6,6),-Y)`, `(3,1,19,(8,7,14),+Z)`.
These were calculated independently with integer arithmetic from the static call
order, not captured from Windows.

`TakeClosestEmptyNode` caches max(X,Y)/3; all supported XP layouts have major 15,
so this limit is five shells. Its faces probe Z/Y, X/Z or X/Y respectively,
with 2*area+1 attempts before ordered fallback. Empty equal ranges do not draw RNG.
The chase flag has only constructor-zero and activation-one writes in the selected
STATE routines; natural resets deliberately retain it.

A retired leader's last valid coordinates remain available through the restart
prepass. This preserves intended order without the original's potential dangling
pointer read; compaction and random leader replacement occur before the drawing
pass. No dangling pointers are emulated.

## Textured path

The exposed picker formats are BMP/JPEG/TGA/PNG (resource 3015). Single/Elbow
textured startup at seed 42 and 15×8×15 reserves head (4,1,10), material 26,
RNG `ccdc561e`: the extra PickRandomTexture(1) sample is not skipped. Budgets
are three/four starts for single/multiple. UV repeat rounding includes +0.5
before truncation (0100e977 assembly), not merely floor(viewport/texture/8).
See [reconstruction notes](../../docs/RECONSTRUCTION.md) for mesh, decoder and explicitly unresolved
out-of-range D3DRS_WRAP0 behavior. The VM uses a newly authored diagnostic PNG,
not Microsoft's bitmap; the GPU test checks sampling, alpha/depth and cleanup.

## Evidence ledger / porting constraints

| Behavior | Binary address | Evidence / constraint |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rand/range samplers | 01010786, 0100e18e, 0100e1b4, 0100e1fb | Assembly; integer scaling is /32768, float sampler differs |
| free-node search/direction | 0100b39d, 0100b67f | Preserve probe order, reservation and failed-direction sentinel 7 |
| normal object/start/draw | 0100b936, 0100bb3d, 0100bdf5 | Construction-time straightness survives a restart |
| normal joint selection | 0100c1b8 | Selection/reset ordering must be followed at the caller |
| frame reset/active objects | 0100f5ce, 0100f8d3 | Preserve constructor and discarded RNG calls; chase flag can persist |
| meshes/layout | 0100bee3, 0100fac8 | x87 integer conversions require assembly, not incomplete pseudocode |
| materials | 0100aec3, 01084380, 010843c0 | Material identity is not one diffuse colour |
| speed gate | 0100dcd5 | Per-render-unit time, no catch-up loop |
| clear/fade | 0100ecfd | Shared counter; fresh uninterrupted fade has 29 overlays then clear |
| rotation | 0100fb98, 0104872e | Literal rotation parameter, not an assumed degree conversion |
| texture loading | 0100ea7f | Default-resource fallback and preprocessing affect appearance |

Assembly and exports remain outside this public repository.
See [reconstruction notes](../../docs/RECONSTRUCTION.md) for the evidence reports. Add fixtures alongside
the rule that uses them, identifying static versus runtime evidence. Whole-scene
and image conformance remain explicitly unverified until independent captures exist.
